subject.title: Bug: Feishu DM Session Enters Infinite Loop After Subagent Announce Trigger

question: Should this be solved as a generic subagent completion handoff/autonomous-run guard, a Feishu-specific channel guard, or tracked under an existing subagent-announce canonical issue?
rationale: The remaining behavior spans generic subagent completion handoff, Feishu channel queue/self-echo behavior, chat-history pressure, and possible autonomous-run policy; automation should not choose that product boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Generic handoff guard plus Feishu proof
options.body: Treat the issue as a generic subagent/session-state bug and require a fix that prevents userless completion handoffs from starting unbounded direct runs, with focused Feishu DM replay proof.

options.title: Feishu-only mitigation
options.body: Constrain the repair to Feishu inbound/outbound loop behavior and keep broader subagent completion policy in separate issues.

options.title: Canonicalize under a related subagent issue
options.body: Move remaining work to a narrower existing subagent announce issue only if maintainers confirm that item fully owns the Feishu DIRECT-loop symptom.

recommendation.title: Generic handoff guard plus Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Treat the issue as a generic subagent/session-state bug and require a fix that prevents userless completion handoffs from starting unbounded direct runs, with focused Feishu DM replay proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest recent current-main history across both the Feishu partial fix and subagent completion delivery surface.
